item.title: Exercise is Medicine: From Concept to Practice — How Far Have We Come?
item.description: The first podcast episode explores the policy trajectory and practical progress of Exercise is Medicine, sharing observations from sports industry expos and academic conferences.
item.content:encoded:
## About This Episode
"Exercise is Medicine" is repeatedly mentioned in policy documents — but how far has it actually progressed in practice? In this episode, I draw on my own research experience to discuss the origins and evolution of this concept, as well as innovative practices emerging across China.
## Key Topics
### Policy Timeline - 2016: The *"Healthy China 2030" Planning Outline* first incorporated "sport-medicine integration" into a national-level policy document - 2021: The *National Fitness Plan (2021–2025)* further emphasized "Exercise is Medicine" - In the upcoming 15th Five-Year Plan, Exercise is Medicine is expected to play an even more prominent role
### Local Practice Cases Zhejiang, Shanghai, Shenzhen, and other regions have begun piloting models that combine "exercise prescription" with community health management. Zhejiang's approach is particularly noteworthy — community health centers issue exercise prescriptions, and certified social sports instructors follow up on their implementation.
### Core Challenges - Doctors don't understand exercise, and sports professionals don't understand medicine — how do we break down these professional silos? - The payment question: who pays for exercise prescriptions? Can health insurance cover them? - Standardization: what counts as a "qualified" exercise prescription?
### My Reflections Exercise is Medicine is not purely a sports issue — it is a social governance challenge. It requires cross-departmental coordination among health commissions, sports bureaus, and education departments. The researcher's mission is to provide quantifiable evidence that can drive policy innovation.
## How to Listen
This episode is available on the Ximalaya platform — search for "Sports Humanities Dialogue" to listen.

item.title: 体卫融合：从理念到实践，我们走了多远？
item.description: 第一期播客深入探讨体卫融合的政策脉络与实践进展，分享我在体博会和学术会议上的观察与思考。
item.content:encoded:
## 本期简介
"体卫融合"在政策文件中被反复提及，但在实践中到底推进到了什么程度？这一期，我从自己的研究经历出发，聊聊这个概念的来龙去脉，以及全国各地涌现的创新实践。
## 本期要点
### 政策时间线 - 2016年：《"健康中国2030"规划纲要》首次将"体医融合"写入国家顶层文件 - 2021年：《全民健身计划（2021-2025年）》进一步强调"体卫融合" - "十五五"规划编制中，体卫融合预计会占据更重要的位置
### 地方实践案例 浙江、上海、深圳等地已经开始试点"运动处方"与社区健康管理相结合的模式。浙江的做法尤其值得关注——让社区卫生服务中心开出运动处方，由社会体育指导员跟进执行。
### 核心挑战 - 医生不懂运动，体育人不了解医学——专业壁垒如何打破？ - 支付问题：运动处方谁来买单？医保能不能覆盖？ - 标准化：什么样的运动处方是"合格"的？
### 我的思考 体卫融合不是一个单纯的体育问题，而是一个社会治理课题。它需要卫健委、体育局、教育部的跨部门协同。研究者的使命是提供可量化的证据，从而推动政策创新。
## 收听方式
本期播客音频可在喜马拉雅平台搜索"体育人文对话"收听。
